characters.scene: An elderly male dwarf of Durane, genuinely short powerful dwarf proportions, deeply creased angular face, one clouded blind eye, short iron-gray beard held in three metal bands. In three-quarter side view he kneels on one knee at a broken parapet and measures a distant wall through a small mechanical sight while holding an original long straight rail rifle resting securely on the parapet. Rifle has two parallel perfectly straight dark metal rails, a thick stone-inlaid stock, precisely suspended MINERO stone segments in a guarded cradle, restrained white-gray magnetic glow; hands naturally on stock and fore-end. His expression is hesitant recognition, not rage. The weapon may project past the edge rather than bending. Cold daylight behind a single broad pale stone wall, tiny warm glow under the breech; quiet worn dust in foreground, no skyline clutter.

Seated sideways on a low stone bench, gently smiling with exhausted concentration while calibrating an ingenious medical tuning fork held clearly in her right hand against a hinged mineral splint held in her left. The fork is an elegant brass and dark stone instrument, softly resonating greenish earth light, no electric hospital machinery. Two visible hands, no patient or disconnected limb. Boots and generous practical clothing fully visible. One doctor's satchel, a broad tunnel arch and a shaded amber lamp are the only background features, warm light on lined face and cool gray mine depths. Intimate but heroic.
